name: Inspiration
overview: The Scriptures reveal that divine inspiration involves God directly communicating His commands and guidance to His people, as seen when He instructs Moses to speak to Israel and places the testimony within the ark (Exodus 19:6; 25:21). God’s presence and communication are symbolized by the mercy seat, where He communes with Moses to impart His will (Exodus 25:22). Furthermore, God empowers leaders by sharing His Spirit with the elders to help bear the responsibilities of guiding the people (Numbers 11:16-17), demonstrating that inspiration is both a divine impartation of authority and instruction. This underscores the importance of looking to God’s revealed word and Spirit for true inspiration in leadership and life.
